items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I learned Sammy Price how to play piano.

ctx.x: He used to be a dancer around here.
Yeah, that's right. I'll tell you somebody else who was a dancer. Sammy Price.

items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I said Buster Smith, didn't I?

ctx.x: Yeah.. Was Lester around then? In Kansas City?

Lester was there and was one of the most outstanding musicians and stylists that I've ever met. I don't ever remember having met a person that was as unique. And he was sort of like a cute man, you know, and he was a man, too, but he was cute. He was just a cute man...sweet, high, nice, polite, kind, but mean as hell. But all of the good parts always came out of him at all times. And...Lester Young. Who did I leave out that was...well, no...I said Buster Smith, didn't I?
